thread:
Jordan (sales-eng): FYI customer in APAC POC hitting `model not found` and intermittent 429s when we try to pin 2.1. They need a quick unblock for demo tomorrow.
Priya (solutions): Can you paste the exact error + region? Which model id are they pinning? :thinking:
Jordan (sales-eng): region=ap-southeast-1, pin=model-redwood-2.1. Error from API: `404 model unavailable in region`. Then after switching to model-redwood-2.1-quant we see 429s on burst tests.
Sam (eng-runtime): Thanks — two separate issues. 1) model-redwood-2.1 hasn't been deployed to APAC hardware yet (deprecated upstream image we removed). 2) 429s look like burst throttling because their test client hits many short requests without batching.
Jordan (sales-eng): Customer insists on pinning exact version for QA. Any temporary workaround that preserves pin semantics?
Sam (eng-runtime): Short-term: we can create a region-aware alias that maps model-redwood-2.1 -> model-redwood-2.1-quant-apac and mark it as compatible for routing. That keeps the pinned name but routes to the quantized variant. Need deployment + infra approval.
Maria (security): If we route to a quantized variant, confirm it's the same model family and that KMS/keys are identical. Customer security wants KMS audit proof before accepting alias mapping.
Jordan (sales-eng): They also asked about SLAs — can we guarantee latency for quantized variant? Demo only needs functional correctness for now.
Sam (eng-runtime): Quantized variant has slightly higher token latency variance but meets our functional tests. For demo: yes. For production we'd recommend Dedicated or Private with pinned full-precision.
Priya (solutions): Can we flip an infra flag for this customer only? We need a scoped rollout so it doesn't affect other tenants.
Sam (eng-runtime): Yes, we can create a traffic policy scoped to the customer's account id. I'll open a deploy with canary route and a short-lived alias. /deploy bot will post status.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout/alias-apac-1951112223 -> model-redwood-2.1-quant-apac (canary 10%)
Sam (eng-runtime): Also increasing their rate limit window for 30 minutes to avoid 429s during the demo. Note: this is temporary and will incur cost.
Jordan (sales-eng): Please confirm KMS audit lines for Maria and I'll relay to customer.
Maria (security): Need the KMS key id and a note that no model weights were changed; alias is routing only. Also require retention of access logs for 90 days. Approve after those are documented.
Sam (eng-runtime): KMS key: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/abc-quant-kms-1951. No weight changes. Logs will be exported to the customer's audit bucket for 90 days. I'll attach the link when deploy finishes.
deploy-bot: deploy success: alias-apac-1951112223 -> model-redwood-2.1-quant-apac (100% after canary). audit-log: https://audit.redwood.internal/logs/1951112223
Jordan (sales-eng): sharing to customer now. Thanks everyone — will confirm if demo passes and follow up for production path (dedicated/private + full-precision pin).
Priya (solutions): Add a note to the SOW: temporary alias + increased rate window for demo, production plan TBD. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (sales-eng): demo passed. Customer accepted quantized alias for now, security signed off with the KMS/audit link. Marking this resolved.
